content.value: You want to store the result of different courses you attended this semester. So, you decided (15) use a generic class Result’ that has two member variables —course\_code’ which is a string by default but can vary, and course\_outcome' which can be a grade point (float), obtained mark (int) or letter grade (string). Now, design the generic class ‘Result’ with parameterized and default constructor.
